answer: Adjacency ridge requirement: an agent may transact only if its address sits on the network's current ridge—a set of positions reachable through at most two distinct neighbor clusters, recomputed each epoch. Connections inside a single cluster (a vault of mutually-linked agents) don't count toward ridge placement; only edges crossing between clusters do. Each crossing edge must anchor to a wharf: a long-lived relay endpoint that has itself spanned clusters for several epochs.
